manifest.purpose: Bounded deterministic regression and exploratory synthetic comparison; no strategy certification.
manifest.matchedTeamDesign: Both seats of the selected partnership use the new policy; the opposing partnership uses the frozen baseline. Pair each hand with the same seed, dealer and team from baseline-vs-baseline. These 48 hands are counted separately.
manifest.scoreMargin: Own score minus largest opposing competitor hand score; in partnership this is team score minus opposing team score.
manifest.grouping: All modes, seats and arms for one deal seed are correlated. Preserve seed grouping in any later inference.
limitations: Comparison seeds are fixed before this run but are an exploratory regression set, not a final held-out strength test.
The frozen local baseline is the only opponent family in the paired comparison.
Paired comparison hands start with zero prior score and bags. Separate reachable carryover cases test scoring/termination, not comparative match strength.
All-new composition hands test interaction and termination; they are not independent paired strength measurements.
Matched-team results test coordination against this one synthetic opponent family; they do not certify general partnership strength.
Scenario counts show encountered conditions, not independently labelled strategic correctness.
No human expertise, calibrated probabilities, causal learning benefit or optimal play is established.
